@sidecar.role: OpenGL 4.3 compute (GL_ARB_compute_shader + SSBO) GPU provider for json_runtime — declared, measured, then admitted by XCFE/KUHUL

@doc.concept: A sidecar is a JSON manifest that declares a capability bundle for the Object Server (json_runtime.exe). JSON declares; XCFE/KUHUL executes. Sidecars are the device drivers of the JSON operating system: every service is a manifest, every program is an @op node graph, every tensor in flight is an XJSON object, every model identity is an atomic.manifest.json.
@doc.object_server: json_runtime.exe is an ASX JSON/XCFE object server: it stores, serves, and EXECUTES JSON documents (programs, tensors, manifests, sidecars, SCXQ2 IR). Unlike a passive database, it runs the objects it stores — XCFE executes programs, tensor_runtime computes, gpu_dispatch compiles kernels, sidecars dispatch ops.
@doc.semantic_graphic_processor: json_runtime is a semantic graphic processor + REST API sandbox: it ingests, stores, and executes semantic graphs (SCXQ2 IR, K'UHUL AST, fold graphs, XJSON tensors) behind sandboxed /api/* routes with phase gating and authority admission. Per the Hive's SH-Wave-Lattice principle: not rendering. Computing.
@doc.shader_expert_system: From E:\models\.hive\SHADER_EXPERT_SYSTEM.md: shader types are tensor experts with phase arrays, geodesic weights, parallel lanes, and tensor code. The router computes a phase from the shader signature, finds the closest expert by pi-geodesic distance, dispatches top-1 (extensible to top-K). This GLSL sidecar is the json_runtime admission point for that MoE shader routing — GLSL compute is the universal expert lane.
@doc.hive: The Hive (E:\models\.hive) is the swarm root; json_runtime is its primary backend. All micronauts (PM-1, BR-1, KX-1, SW-1, CP-1, ...) route through the native C++ REST API. SW-1 is the swarm dispatcher. Micronaut lifecycle: factory create -> validate (Yax) -> SCXQ2 pack (Xul) -> BSON bind (Xul); semantic_key = glyph + lane + binary_runtime_array.
@doc.json_without_javascript: JSON is a data format, not a JavaScript feature. The Object Server is pure C++ (nlohmann/json + its own XCFE evaluator). JavaScript (Node) appears only in the orchestration layer (kuhul-server.cjs) over HTTP. Any language can declare, store, and execute the same JSON documents.
@doc.full_doc: SIDECARS.md (same directory) — sidecar concept, Object Server basics, JSON/AST convergence, JSON-without-JS, micronaut hive

@gpu.policy: GLSL is the universal GPU path (every GPU since 2012). json_runtime dispatches GLSL compute through this sidecar; device dispatch routes to gl_infer_driver.dll / xcfe_gl_ops.dll / GLSL_Server.
